summary: Iteration 13: Regular Clients dashboard + customer feedback/review collector. Backend pytest 13/13 passed (recurring list fields, no payment_method/stripe_customer leak, card_saved, visits/last_visit, staff 403, pause/resume/cancel incl. resume-without-card 400 and cancelled-is-final 400; complete booking -> feedback_token + 'How did we do?' email with correct https://{host}/feedback/{id}?t= link; feedback info suggested_name 'First L.'; wrong token 404; rating/name validation 422; submit creates review source=customer_feedback platform=website booking_id publish_consent status new / needs_attention (<=3) + owner notification; duplicate submit 409 and done=true; public reviews include consented (verified true, no internal fields) and exclude non-consented and hidden; admin PATCH hidden/hidden_reason; staff completes own job (token set) and 403 on others). Frontend (Playwright) all flows pass: admin nav -> /admin/regular-clients, stat cards correct (Expected/month 533.33 then 360.00 after cancel = weekly 60x52/12 + fortnightly 80x26/12 + monthly 100), tabs filter correctly, Pause/Resume/Cancel (with confirm) update status and stats, cancelled rows have no buttons; feedback page invalid token -> feedback-invalid, name prefilled, submit disabled until star chosen, consent checkbox, submit -> feedback-thanks, reload -> thanks; /reviews shows card with site-review-verified 'Verified customer · Residential / Regular Clean'; admin Reviews review-web-status shows 'Shown on your website', hide button prompts for reason, toggles to 'Hidden from website: <reason>' and back, public API reflects it. All TEST_ data deleted.

minor.issue: No 404 for unknown id (returns ok:true) and `status` accepts any string; hidden can be set on non-consented reviews (harmless).
feedback_info does `first, *rest = name.split()` - a booking with empty/whitespace customer name would 500. Edge case.

ui_bugs.issue: If the customer submits twice (e.g. two tabs), the 409 only shows an error toast; the form stays instead of switching to the thanks/done state.

integration_issues.issue: FeedbackPage uses DEFAULT_SLUG ('solid-clean') for the API call and the email link is /feedback/{id} (no /c/{slug}). For any other CleanOps tenant the link would show 'This link is not valid'. Same pre-existing pattern as /tip and /results. Fine for Solid Clean.

issues: 4th KPI tile (trend line chart) renders almost empty - just a dot visible - looks broken with few data points; consider a label/axis or minimum height
Floating chat bubble overlaps right edge of the name input / consent line; sticky Call us/Book online bar covers the lower form until scrolled - consider hiding the sticky CTA bar on /feedback

design_issues.issue_note: hide() has no try/catch - API error would be an unhandled promise without toast

action_items: Optional: on 409 from feedback submit, set the page to thanks/done state
Optional: guard empty customer name in feedback_info; 404 in patch_review for unknown id
Optional: tenant-aware feedback/tip/results links (/c/{slug}/feedback/...) if other tenants will use this
Optional: hide sticky CTA bar/chat bubble on /feedback mobile; add try/catch to Reviews hide()
critical_code_review_comments: list_plans correctly pops payment_method and projects out stripe_customer; out() strips _id
submit_feedback race-safe via conditional update on review_id $exists:false + rollback delete - good
public_reviews filter correct: excludes demo, hidden, and non-consented customer_feedback
